decisions.statement: A person opts in only by checking the box themselves.
The wording shown beside the box is the whole wording the consent module states.
A field no person is shown catches a caller filling every field.
A refusal the route states is shown as the refusal was given.
Nothing here writes the consent down.
The wording and the links beside the box read as one sentence rather than as a row.
Each link beside the box reaches a whole document rather than a section here.

definition: the form a person opts in to text messages through
